dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: はい。宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: 時間前ですが始めてもよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: It's a little before our scheduled time, but would it be alright to start?

dialogue.content: はい。大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Okay, let's begin.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 私の父親との関係で悩んでいます。
dialogue.English: I’m struggling with my relationship with my father.

dialogue.content: お父さんですね
dialogue.English: Your father, I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうしましたか
dialogue.English: What has been going on?

dialogue.content: 離れた所に母と2人で暮らしてるので、心配なんですが、父は私の言う事を聞いてくれなくて、イライラします。
dialogue.English: He lives far away with my mother, and I'm worried about them. But my father won't listen to anything I say, and it's frustrating.

dialogue.content: おとｈとお母さんはおいくつですか？
dialogue.English: How old are your fath... and your mother?

dialogue.content: お父さんです
dialogue.English: I mean your father.

dialogue.content: 88歳と84歳です
dialogue.English: He's 88 and she's 84.

dialogue.content: 90さいちかいのではしんぱいですね
dialogue.English: Being close to 90, it's understandable to be worried.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: すみませパソコンじようたいがふぐあいをおこしてしまいおそくなりました
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, my computer was having issues, which caused a delay.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です
dialogue.English: That's okay.

dialogue.content: 慌てないでくださいね
dialogue.English: Please don't rush.

dialogue.content: どのようおはなしのとき聴いていただけないのですか
dialogue.English: In what kind of conversations does he not listen to you?

dialogue.content: ある意味、何もかもです。これからの生活の事なんですが悩む、悩むといいながら、人の話を聞いてないです。
dialogue.English: In a way, almost everything. He says he’s worried about their life going forward, but he doesn’t listen to what others say.

dialogue.content: それではイライラしてしまいますね
dialogue.English: That must be very frustrating.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。段々と腹が立ってきています。
dialogue.English: Yes. I’m getting increasingly angry.

dialogue.content: ご両親の健康状態は
dialogue.English: How is your parents' health?

dialogue.content: 今のところ何とか大丈夫何ですが、年始に父親が体調を崩して、入院した事があります。
dialogue.English: For now they’re managing somehow, but at the beginning of the year my father fell ill and was hospitalized.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか。。それでは余計に心配のなりますよね
dialogue.English: I see. That must make you even more worried.

dialogue.content: なのに、余り以前と生活を変えない、というか…不安だという割には、何も変えないんです。
dialogue.English: And yet, he hasn't changed his lifestyle much from before... I mean, for someone who says he's anxious, he doesn't change anything.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。近くにはどなたかいらっしゃいますか
dialogue.English: I see. Is there anyone living near them?

dialogue.content: 近所の方くらいですね。入院した時も助けて貰ったみたいですが、何度もという訳にはいかないですよね
dialogue.English: Just the neighbors, really. It seems they helped him when he was hospitalized, but we can't rely on them all the time.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 食事は大丈夫なんですか？
dialogue.English: Are they managing with meals?

dialogue.content: 今ですか？
dialogue.English: Do you mean now?

dialogue.content: 入院の時？
dialogue.English: Or when he was hospitalized?

dialogue.content: はい今です
dialogue.English: Yes, now.

dialogue.content: 母が作ってると思います。
dialogue.English: I think my mother is cooking for them.

dialogue.content: きっとお父さんは今のままで充分と思っているのかしら？
dialogue.English: Perhaps your father feels things are fine as they are?

dialogue.content: いえ、今後の事を考えると、不安で眠れないらしいです。
dialogue.English: No, apparently he's so anxious about the future that he can't sleep.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。どうしてもらいたいのでしょうかね？
dialogue.English: I see. What is it that he wants, I wonder?

dialogue.content: 私からしたら、何がしたいか分からなくなりました。もう、何年もこの調子で、イライラします。
dialogue.English: From my perspective, I no longer know what he wants to do. It’s been like this for years, and it makes me frustrated.

dialogue.content: 私の言う事は聞かないですから
dialogue.English: Because he won't listen to what I say.

dialogue.content: お話しをまとめて見ると、遠くにいるご両親、とくにお父さんは言うことを全然聞いてkurenakuteいらいらしているで宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: To summarize, your parents live far away, and in particular your father doesn’t listen to you at all and you feel frustrated—does that sound right?

dialogue.content: はい。どうしたらいいんでしょう。
dialogue.English: Yes. What should I do?

dialogue.content: 遠く離れているので、お父さんは自分でyarusikanaito頑張っておられるのかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: Since you’re far apart, your father may feel he has no choice but to manage on his own and is trying hard.

dialogue.content: そうですね。でも、私からしたら、意固地にしか見えません。どうせいつかは自分1人で出来なくなるのに
dialogue.English: That's true. But to me, it just looks like he's being stubborn. Eventually, he won't be able to do things by himself anyway.

dialogue.content: まだまだできるぞって！まだ元気だとみせているのかしらね！
dialogue.English: He might be trying to show, “I can still do it! I’m still fine!”

dialogue.content: きっと寄り添ってもらいたいときがきますよね
dialogue.English: I’m sure the time will come when he’ll want someone by his side.

dialogue.content: 自分が病気で倒れたりしたら、余計に大変なのに。自分1人で牛耳ってるから対処の仕様がないし。その時に、いきなり助けてと言われても、だから、人の言う事聞きなさいって言ったのに、とか思ってしまいます。
dialogue.English: It will be even more difficult if he collapses from illness. He's controlling everything by himself, so there's no way to deal with it. If he suddenly asks for help then, I'd just think, "This is why I told you to listen to people."

dialogue.content: 老いては子に従ってもらいたいですけどね
dialogue.English: It's true, you'd wish that as parents age, they'd listen to their children.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよ。
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: このことを家族に相談してみましたか
dialogue.English: Have you discussed this with your family?

dialogue.content: はい。家族は、もうほっといた方がいいと言ってます。意固地だから。でも、私は娘だから、やっぱりほっとけない。で、1人でイライラしてます。
dialogue.English: Yes. My family says it's better to just leave him be, because he's stubborn. But since I'm his daughter, I can't just leave him alone. So I'm the only one getting frustrated.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。ご両親の近くに住んでいる民生委員さんにおねがいはしてありますか
dialogue.English: I see. Have you tried asking a community welfare commissioner who lives near your parents for help?

dialogue.content: それは私が何度も説得して最近、ケアマネ？の人が担当に付きました。私も一度会いました。
dialogue.English: I kept persuading them, and recently a care manager has been assigned. I’ve met them once as well.

dialogue.content: そうですか少しは安心ですね
dialogue.English: I see. That must be a bit of a relief.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お任せするところはおまかせして電話で貴方の声を聞かせて下さい。ご両親はあんしんするし、あなたから元気をいただきます
dialogue.English: Let the professionals handle what they can, and just let your parents hear your voice over the phone. They will feel relieved and draw energy from you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: このままでいいですか？
dialogue.English: Is it okay to just leave things as they are?

dialogue.content: まだまだやり取りで足りないところがありましたが
dialogue.English: There were still some parts of our conversation that felt incomplete.

dialogue.content: イライラする私が間違っているんですかね？
dialogue.English: Am I wrong for feeling so frustrated?

dialogue.content: あ、すみません
dialogue.English: Oh, I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: 時間ですね
dialogue.English: It’s time, isn’t it?

dialogue.content: またゆっくりきてお話を聞かせてくださいね
dialogue.English: Please come back again when you have time and we can talk more.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: パソコンの不具合などすみませんでした。
dialogue.English: I’m sorry about the computer trouble and everything.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です。失礼します。
dialogue.English: That's alright. Goodbye.

dialogue.content: またお待ちしております今日はこれ終了させて頂きます。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I look forward to seeing you again. We'll end our session here for today. Thank you.
